title: morus alba subvar. columbassetta
intro: Morus alba subvar. columbassetta, commonly known as white mulberry, is a variety of mulberry tree known for its medicinal properties and edible fruit. The plant is rich in health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been shown to help reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cardiovascular disease and diabetes. The therapeutic actions of Morus alba subvar. columbassetta include anti-arthritic, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Morus alba subvar. columbassetta also include anthocyanins, which have been shown to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a valuable plant for traditional medicine.
